thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Multiple regions reporting elevated 5xxs and tail latency on chat and embeddings since ~02:14 UTC. Key: edge.egress.throttle. Paging @Samir Patel and @oncall-network.
Samir Patel: oncall here. grabbing network egress metrics and CDN dashboards. any recent infra or CDN config changes?
Jules Kim: nothing on our side. CDN partner shows bursts of rate-limited egress from our APAC and EU POPs starting ~02:10 UTC. They report a policy enforcement for anomalous flow aggregates.
Alex Chen: traces show increased retry loops and timeouts during egress handoff. p99 for chat and p95 for embeddings jumped sharply. many requests get 502/503 when upstream connections reset.
Samir Patel: ok — likely external throttling. mitigation options: 1) route traffic to alternate egress POPs, 2) failover heavy tenants to multi-region endpoints (us-east), 3) request emergency quota bump from CDN (+provide telemetry), 4) enable conservative client-side retry/backoff and reduce concurrency for affected tenants. implement in that order.
Maya (CS): compiling affected customer list. will hold outbound messaging until we have clear ETA.
ops-automation: action_log: initiating routing override to prefer global-egress-2 for APAC and EU at 02:22 UTC.
Samir Patel: applying route override now — `redwoodctl routing set --from-region=apac --prefer-egress=global-egress-2`
ops-automation: routing override applied at 02:23 UTC. estimated propagation 60s.
Alex Chen: after override, immediate drop in connection resets from 18% -> 4% on sampled requests; p99 improving but still elevated due to backlog.
Jules Kim: opening support ticket with CDN: ticket CDN-EMERG-8721 created at 02:25 UTC requesting clarification and quota bump. attaching sample flow logs and AS paths.
Samir Patel: enabling tenant failover for the heaviest tenants: t-4401, t-9912, t-2200. Priya, can you prepare short advisory for those account owners? Maya will coordinate outreach.
Priya Rao: drafting targeted advisory (internal): "We detected intermittent 5xx errors and higher latency for APAC/EU traffic due to third-party egress rate limiting. We've applied temporary routing overrides and failovers for critical tenants; you may still see intermittent errors while backfills drain. We'll update once CDN confirms resolution. Suggested action: consider routing critical traffic to a stable region (us-east) while we resolve with the CDN."
Maya (CS): will send to account owners once Samir confirms stable metrics. holding public message until p99 < 1.2s for 10m.
ops-automation: metric-check: apac.chat.p99=1.6s (was 5.8s), eu.embed.p95=0.9s (was 2.4s), global.502_rate=0.8% (baseline 0.05%).
Alex Chen: backlog draining but we still see a handful of hot tenants spiking retry storms which can re-trigger CDN policing. recommend temporary per-tenant concurrency caps + backoff enforcement.
Samir Patel: applying per-tenant caps: t-4401->60% concurrency, t-9912->50%, t-2200->40% for 20m. ops-automation, apply now.
ops-automation: action_log: tenant caps applied at 02:36 UTC.
Jules Kim: CDN support responded: they saw aggregated egress above threshold and enacted automatic shaping. They've accepted our ticket and are expediting a temporary quota increase for our account; ETA unknown but likely within 60-120 minutes.
Samir Patel: good. create follow-up infra ticket INF-NET-701 to track permanent mitigations: multi-pop egress redundancy, early detection of egress shaping, and per-tenant shaping protection.
Samir Patel: drafting status page text (internal): "Investigating: Partial service degradation affecting APAC and EU inference traffic causing intermittent 5xxs and higher latency. Engineers have applied routing overrides and tenant failovers; CDNs are engaged. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."
Priya Rao: internal comms template for account teams: "Summary: Third-party egress throttling affected APAC/EU; impact: intermittent 5xxs and increased tail latency for chat and embeddings. Mitigations: routing overrides to alternate egress POPs, tenant failovers to multi-region endpoints, temporary per-tenant concurrency caps, CDN engagement for quota relief. ETA: improvement observed; full resolution depends on CDN but likely within 1-2 hours. Recommended customer actions: route critical traffic to us-east, reduce concurrency and batch sizes, contact CS for prioritized failover."
Maya (CS): saving templates to incident record under /incidents/2192468000/comm-templates. prepping targeted outbound to impacted enterprise accounts.
Alex Chen: sampling increased to 15% and io logs attached to INF-NET-701. observed no internal config changes — this is external policy enforcement.
ops-automation: status-page: POST /api/v1/incidents -> status_id s-11092 created at 02:40 UTC.
Maya (CS): public status draft (final): "Partial degradation: some customers in APAC and EU may experience increased latency and intermittent 5xx errors due to third-party egress shaping. Engineers have applied routing overrides and are working with our CDN partner for mitigation. We expect continued improvement; next update in 30 minutes."
Samir Patel: handing off monitoring to Jules at 02:45 UTC. @Alex, @Priya, @Maya please shadow 02:45-03:15 for validation and customer follow-ups. Handoff note: routing overrides in place, tenant caps active, CDN ticket CDN-EMERG-8721 open, follow-up INF-NET-701. Escalate if 5xx_rate > 1% or p99 > 2.5s.
Jules Kim: taking. will monitor and request escalation from CDN if shaping re-appears. will also coordinate post-incident RCA about egress redundancy.
Maya (CS): will publish public status now and start one-off emails to impacted customers.
incident-bot: public status posted: id s-11092 at 02:41 UTC.
Samir Patel: closing active paging for now. please add any customer responses or metric regressions as replies in this thread. :white_check_mark:
